name: stat
summary: Shows all the information about a file.
description: Details what ls -l summarizes: size, number of blocks, inode, links, permissions in octal and in letters, owner and group (name and number), and three dates (last access, last content change, last metadata change).

options.description: Custom output format: %a (permissions in octal), %A (in letters), %s (size), %U (owner), %y (modification date), %n (name)…
Like -c, but interprets \n and adds no final newline.
For a symbolic link, describes the target rather than the link.
Describes the file system that contains the file.

example.output:
Type: ext2/ext3  Block size: 4096
Blocks: Total: 61202941  Free: 32504138

examples.explanation: All the information about the file.
examples.output:
File: file1
  Size: 47        	Blocks: 8          IO Block: 4096   regular file
Device: 8,2	Inode: 1837465     Links: 1
Access: (0664/-rw-rw-r--)  Uid: ( 1000/  esprit)   Gid: ( 1000/  esprit)
Modify: 2024-07-12 21:14:05.000000000 +0200

examples.explanation: Permissions in octal, owner and name of each file.
The exact size in bytes, handy in a script.
